MedPass

EIGHT STEPS · EIGHT RIGHTS · EVERY PATIENT, EVERY TIME

The Pass — Step by Step

Window

  • The patient comes to you.
  • Open BCMA in Scan Mode.
🪟🖥️
➜

Bracelet Scan

  • Greet the patient and scan their bracelet.
  • Ask for their full name and last four of SSN.
👋📷🗣️
➜

Greet + ID

  • Correct patient loaded in BCMA.
  • Verify patient ID — full name and SSN.
👤=🪪
➜

Omnicell

  • Log in
  • Verify Patient ID
  • Select Remove All
  • Remove Meds
🖥️🔐🧑📤

Scan Meds

  • Scan every med.
  • Review meds with patient as each is scanned.
  • Open meds; place in cup.
📷💊👀🥤
➜

Give + Watch

  • Provide Med + Water
  • Observe Taken
  • Assist as Needed
💊💧👀🤝
➜

Confirm

  • Check BCMA for Given “G”
  • Rescan if Needed
  • Resolve Discrepancies
✅🔁🔍
➜

Verify

  • Read every BCMA message.
  • Verify against the live order + allergy record.
  • A quiet screen is not a safe pass.
🔔📋👀
The Eight Rights

Patient

Name + LAST FOUR

Medication

Ordered med

Dose

Ordered amount

Route

As Directed

Time

Due — not given, not held

Indication

Why this med, right now?

Docs

What actually happened?

Response

Did it work?

BCMA machine-checks the first five. Your judgment supplies the last three — every time.

PINCH — Handle With Care

Potassium

Concentrated electrolytes

Insulin

All types

Narcotics

Controlled meds

Chemotherapy

Cytotoxics

Heparin

+ anticoagulants

High Alert

⚠ SLOW IS FAST

Extra checks, second verifier. In this guide:

Insulin LisproInsulin GlargineDextrose 50%MethadoneClozapineLithium
Never
🚫

NO WORKAROUNDS

Never scan a barcode taped to the cart. It defeats the whole system.

🚫

NO BACK-CHARTING

Late docs are invented docs. Never chart a scan that didn’t happen.

🚫

NO UNSEEN DOSES

Cheeking is real. The observed swallow proves it landed.
